NEXT: NEXT: The number you think of vanishes, and only 4 is left?

EN.네 답,|미리 써 놨어: I've already written down your answer
EN.정답은 벌써\n이 봉투 안에!:
The answer is already
in this envelope!
EN.세 자리 수를\n하나 생각해요:
Think of any
three-digit number
(first and last digits at least 2 apart)
EN.거꾸로 뒤집은 수와\n큰 수에서 작은 수를 빼요:
Reverse it, then subtract
the smaller number from the bigger one
EN.그 답을 뒤집어서\n더해요:
Reverse that answer
and add the two together
EN.천천히 하고 싶으면\n화면을 꾹 눌러 멈춰요:
Need more time?
Press and hold the screen to pause
EN.맞았으면 댓글에\n\"1089\"!:
If I got it right,
comment "1089"!
EN.빼고 나온 답은\n딱 8 가지뿐:
After subtracting, there are
only 8 possible answers
EN.가운데는 늘 9\n양 끝을 더해도 9:
The middle digit is always 9,
and the two ends add up to 9
EN.뒤집어 더하면\n자리마다…:
Add it to its reverse,
column by column…
EN.양 끝 9 · 가운데 18\n그래서 언제나 1089!:
Ends make 9, the middle makes 18:
900 + 180 + 9 = 1089, every time!
EN.이제 네가 마술사!:
Now you're the magician! Secretly write 1089 on paper,
have someone do the steps, then unfold it!
